LightningComponentBundle.description: Opens a record in a console tab or subtab, or in the current browser tab outside a console app.

property.name: recordId
property.label: Record ID
property.description: ID of the record to open.

property.name: isSubtab
property.label: Open as Subtab
property.description: Opens the record under the current primary tab instead of in a new primary tab. Ignored outside a console app.

property.name: hasFocus
property.label: Focus Opened Tab
property.description: Brings the opened tab to the foreground. Otherwise, opens it in the background. Ignored outside a console app.
